body: ### Summary On Powershell 5.1, `powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"` creates an error: AI says its because `irm` on powershell 5.1 returns a string array and each line is evaluated independetly, so the block comment `<#` looks unclosed ### Platform Windows ### Version latest ### Python version N/A
title: Powershell Install Fails on Powershell 5.1
